product_family: AI video, image, and sound generation platform with text-to-video, image-to-video, and image generation capabilities. Offers web interface and API access.

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: Kling AI grants itself and parent company Kuaishou a 'worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, and sublicensable license to use, host, store, reproduce, modify, and display content' primarily for improving the service and training future AI models. Users grant broad rights but retain ownership of outputs. Revocable opt-out available.
privacy.data_region: Primary: Singapore; Processing: China (potential dual residency under Kuaishou jurisdiction)

security.name: Data Encryption
security.value: Privacy policy mentions encryption techniques and specialized systems but does not specify TLS/SSL versions, AES standards, or encryption at rest protocols. Details not publicly documented.

security.name: Data Protection Controls
security.value: Specialized information security department; strictly limited personnel access; confidentiality obligations for those with access; unauthorized processing controls.

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Timely incident handling and user notification for data breaches, information leakage, or security incidents via messages or announcements.

security.name: Data Minimization
security.value: By default, only collects and processes data necessary to provide platform access and services.

security.name: Content Moderation & Safety
security.value: Prompt screening, real-time content analysis, and policy rules for content filtering. Watermarking of AI-generated content required by Chinese CAC (Cyberspace Administration) regulations (2023-2024).

security.name: Regulatory Compliance (China)
security.value: Governed by PRC standards including Generative AI Service Management Provisions (effective August 2023). Content filtering and watermarking required.

products.name: Kling 3.0 / Video 3.0
products.data_scope: Text prompts, image inputs, motion control data. Generated videos owned by user but Kuaishou retains sublicensable training/reuse rights.
products.notes: Text-to-video and image-to-video generation with multimodal instruction parsing. Supports long-form storyboard control and cross-scene transitions.

products.name: Image Generation
products.data_scope: Text prompts, reference images. Generated images owned by user but Kuaishou retains sublicensable reuse rights.
products.notes: AI image generator with creative studio interface.

products.name: Sound Generation
products.data_scope: Audio prompts and parameters. Generated audio owned by user; reuse rights granted to Kuaishou.
products.notes: Native Audio-powered feature for voice tone and acoustic generation.

products.name: Kling AI API
products.data_scope: Same as consumer products. API integrations subject to same terms and data usage rights.
products.notes: Enterprise API access for video, image, and sound generation. Separate API terms of service.

products.name: Creative Studio (Web Interface)
products.data_scope: User project data, generation history, account information. Stored primarily on Singapore servers with potential China-based processing.
products.notes: Web-based editing and generation interface. Desktop apps available (macOS, Windows).

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free credits + premium subscriptions). Paid API and membership plans available. Membership tiers with monthly credit limits.
compare.data_residency: Singapore (primary) with potential processing in China; No option for EU data residency; Not GDPR-compliant for regulated industries

flags: NO Western compliance certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, etc.) despite enterprise-scale and global availability
Data processing under Chinese law and PRC jurisdiction; subject to Chinese Generative AI Service Management Provisions
No published GDPR Data Processing Agreement (DPA) or Standard Contractual Clauses despite global/EU access
Dual data residency (Singapore + China) creates GDPR data adequacy risk for EU customers
Trains on customer inputs by default with only revocable opt-out; broad sublicensable reuse rights retained by Kuaishou
Parent company (Kuaishou) is Beijing-based and regulated by Chinese state authorities
VerifyWise Grade B (62/100) is transparency score only, not actual security/compliance audit
Encryption standards (TLS, AES) not specified in public documentation
No trust center or security/compliance documentation on vendor domain
Potential identity confusion: Do NOT conflate with Klang AI AB (Swedish company with separate trust center at trust.klang.ai)
